newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: Vitaliy
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ GAMEPLAY ][/p][list][*][p]Added an option to switch Silent Reload Mode between Hold and Toggle. With toggle enabled, once the silent reload starts you can let go of the reload button. To cancel a silent reload and go back to a fast reload, you can tap the reload button again.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various cases where the first sound of a reload was audible irrespective if a user requested a silent reload or not.[/p][/*][/list][p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where liquid could render as black on AMD video cards[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some sound and UI bugs when rewinding during demo playback[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: Vitaliy
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ UI ][/p][p]Demo/Replay viewer improvements:[/p][list][*][p]Added a progress bar for demo/replay downloads[/p][/*][*][p]Camera controls now use click-and-drag scheme[/p][/*][*][p]Free and chase camera are usable during a paused demo[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some minor issues when seeking to a different position in the demo file[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Round backup files now require the game server startup flag "-allow_round_backup_files"[/p][/*][*][p]Updated AUG reload animations for standing and crouch reloads to better match new reload duration[/p][/*][*][p]Allowed radio commands now have an explicit list[/p][/*][*][p]Added toolsskybox_occluder tool material for CS2 Workshop Tools[/p][/*][*][p]Stability improvements for Vulkan renderer[/p][/*][/list]

newsitems.title: Counter-Strike 2 Update
newsitems.author: Vitaliy
newsitems.contents: [p]\[ MISC ][/p][list][*][p]Added a ping icon for dropped defuse kits[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the time for AUG reload by half second[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the sound event during silent reload for Desert Eagle[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a case of buzzing soundscape sounds during demo playback[/p][/*][*][p]Clipping fixes for Rush maps[/p][/*][*][p]Localization updates[/p][/*][*][p]Stability updates[/p][/*][/list]
